theorem QOU.Hecke.BondCutSymmetry.flavour_tilt_wrong_direction {K : Type u_1} [Field K] [LinearOrder K] [IsStrictOrderedRing K] {q d : K} (hq : 1 < q) (hd : 0 < d) :
1 / (q ^ 2 + 1) < 1 / 2 ∧ 1 / 2 < 1 / 2 + d / 4

theorem QOU.Hecke.BondCutSymmetry.weight_miss_ge_half_hbar {K : Type u_1} [Field K] [LinearOrder K] [IsStrictOrderedRing K] {q : K} (hq : 1 ≤ q) :
(q - 1) / (2 * q) ≤ (q ^ 2 - 1) / (2 * (q ^ 2 + 1))

theorem QOU.Hecke.BondCutSymmetry.bondSum_ne_semf_neutronMatter {K : Type u_1} [Field K] [LinearOrder K] [IsStrictOrderedRing K] {epp epn enn npp npn nnn E0 aV aA A : K} (hepp : 0 ≤ epp) (hepn : 0 ≤ epn) (henn : 0 ≤ enn) (hpp : 0 ≤ npp) (hpn : 0 ≤ npn) (hnn : 0 ≤ nnn) (hE0 : 0 ≤ E0) (hA : 0 < A) (h : aV < aA) :
E0 * bondSum epp epn enn npp npn nnn ≠ aV * A - aA * (A * A / A)

theorem QOU.Hecke.BondCutSymmetry.semf_neutronMatter_neg {K : Type u_1} [Field K] [LinearOrder K] [IsStrictOrderedRing K] {aV aA A : K} (hA : 0 < A) (h : aV < aA) :
aV * A - aA * (A * A / A) < 0

theorem QOU.Hecke.BondCutSymmetry.bondSum_nonneg {K : Type u_1} [Field K] [LinearOrder K] [IsStrictOrderedRing K] {epp epn enn npp npn nnn : K} (hepp : 0 ≤ epp) (hepn : 0 ≤ epn) (henn : 0 ≤ enn) (hpp : 0 ≤ npp) (hpn : 0 ≤ npn) (hnn : 0 ≤ nnn) :
0 ≤ bondSum epp epn enn npp npn nnn

theorem QOU.Hecke.BondCutSymmetry.cut_le_degree_bound {K : Type u_1} [Field K] [LinearOrder K] [IsStrictOrderedRing K] {npp npn nnn dP dN d Z N : K} (hP : 2 * npp + npn = dP) (hN : 2 * nnn + npn = dN) (hpp : 0 ≤ npp) (hnn : 0 ≤ nnn) (hdP : dP ≤ d * Z) (hdN : dN ≤ d * N) :
npn ≤ d * Z ∧ npn ≤ d * N

theorem QOU.Hecke.BondCutSymmetry.symmetryCoeff_pos_iff {K : Type u_1} [Field K] [LinearOrder K] [IsStrictOrderedRing K] {epp epn enn μ : K} (hμ : 0 < μ) :
0 < symmetryCoeff epp epn enn μ ↔ (epp + enn) / 2 < epn

theorem QOU.Hecke.BondCutSymmetry.bondSum_wellMixed_symmetry {K : Type u_1} [Field K] [CharZero K] (epp epn enn k μ Z N : K) :
bondSum epp epn enn ((k * Z - μ * Z * N) / 2) (μ * Z * N) ((k * N - μ * Z * N) / 2) = k / 2 * (epp * Z + enn * N) + symmetryCoeff epp epn enn μ * (Z + N) ^ 2 - symmetryCoeff epp epn enn μ * (N - Z) ^ 2

def QOU.Hecke.BondCutSymmetry.symmetryCoeff {K : Type u_1} [Field K] (epp epn enn μ : K) :
K

theorem QOU.Hecke.BondCutSymmetry.bondSum_wellMixed {K : Type u_1} [Field K] [CharZero K] (epp epn enn k μ Z N : K) :
bondSum epp epn enn ((k * Z - μ * Z * N) / 2) (μ * Z * N) ((k * N - μ * Z * N) / 2) = k / 2 * (epp * Z + enn * N) + energySlope epp epn enn * μ / 4 * ((Z + N) ^ 2 - (N - Z) ^ 2)

theorem QOU.Hecke.BondCutSymmetry.bondSum_segregated_sub {K : Type u_1} [Field K] [CharZero K] (epp epn enn k c Z N Z' N' : K) :
bondSum epp epn enn ((k * Z - c) / 2) c ((k * N - c) / 2) - bondSum epp epn enn ((k * Z' - c) / 2) c ((k * N' - c) / 2) = k / 2 * (epp * (Z - Z') + enn * (N - N'))

theorem QOU.Hecke.BondCutSymmetry.bondSum_chain {K : Type u_1} [Field K] [CharZero K] (epp epn enn Z N : K) :
bondSum epp epn enn (Z - 1) 1 (N - 1) = (epp * (2 * Z - 1) + enn * (2 * N - 1)) / 2 + energySlope epp epn enn * 1

theorem QOU.Hecke.BondCutSymmetry.bondSum_eq_cut {K : Type u_1} [Field K] [CharZero K] (epp epn enn npp npn nnn dP dN : K) (hP : 2 * npp + npn = dP) (hN : 2 * nnn + npn = dN) :
bondSum epp epn enn npp npn nnn = (epp * dP + enn * dN) / 2 + energySlope epp epn enn * npn

def QOU.Hecke.BondCutSymmetry.energySlope {K : Type u_1} [Field K] (epp epn enn : K) :
K

theorem QOU.Hecke.BondCutSymmetry.four_mul_ZN {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (Z N : R) :
4 * (Z * N) = (Z + N) ^ 2 - (N - Z) ^ 2

theorem QOU.Hecke.BondCutSymmetry.two_mul_bondSum {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (epp epn enn npp npn nnn dP dN : R) (hP : 2 * npp + npn = dP) (hN : 2 * nnn + npn = dN) :
2 * bondSum epp epn enn npp npn nnn = epp * dP + enn * dN + (2 * epn - epp - enn) * npn

R
